verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a UI library's ecosystem, but the evidence documents none. The installation docs send users to third-party build tools (Vite, Parcel, Rsbuild) and frameworks (Next.js, React Router). The only install command shown adds a Babel plugin via npm, not a React CLI. The llms.txt file is an adjacent AI-readability feature and does not count as a CLI.
